items.title: MAD Magazine ★ The Animated Version - a kid-friendly version of Robot Chicken
items.description:
MAD Magazine ★ The Animated Version -
AKA 'a kid-friendly version of Robot Chicken'

Some home videos I recorded from Cartoon Network in 2010 ... that I finally decided to upload to the Archive under "Fair Use" Provisions.
